title.narrative: Rights Amplified: Inclusive Development and Social Inclusion for children and families most impacted by discrimination in Kosovo

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is that children, youth and families most impacted by discrimination are empowered and benefit from accessible, quality and gender-responsive social services.


The Specific Objectives (SOs) of this action are:


Outcome 1

Formal and non-formal service providers have the capacity, knowledge and skills for gender mainstreaming and gender responsive, child-sensitive social protection.  


Outcome 2

Girls, boys and women survivors of GBV and Domestic Violence report feeling supported, accepted and valued and have access to tailored social services.  


Outcome 3

Children and youth have increased awareness, are empowered and engaged on children's rights, well-being, and LGBTQI+ issues, leading to improved policies and actions at both municipal and national levels.
